source: Phase 0.5 local PostgreSQL route-handler snapshot and two Phase 3.1 after snapshots

method.timings: Median milliseconds. DB proxy is the sum of node-postgres round trips, not aggregate PostgreSQL execution time. Handler wall excludes HTTP transport.
method.rowsReturnedBySql: Sum of SQL rowCount values, not scanned rows.

queryFlow.note: Prisma batches relation reads; this was duplicate base/location loading, not an N+1.

explainAnalyzeAfter.coursePage: Limit 20; top-N heapsort; joins over small 60-row course/location fixture; one course-root scan in the request. Representative execution 0.400 ms.
explainAnalyzeAfter.teeHoles: Index Scan on holes using idx_hole_tee_id, 540 actual rows, loops 1; quicksort by requested hole order. Representative execution 0.196 ms.
explainAnalyzeAfter.note: Read-only local plans only; no index change.

result: CONFIRMED IMPROVEMENT: two duplicate SQL statements and 40 duplicate root/location returned rows eliminated; result counts and payload bytes unchanged in both after snapshots.
